name: Cumbria Community Foundation Laidlaw Fund for the Environment
summary: Small grants to charitable and not-for-profit organisations for wildlife habitat protection and environmental education projects in Cumbria, with priority for Carlisle and the surrounding area.

amount.note: Normally up to £2,000 over one year

eligibility.rule: Ensure the supported work is legally charitable
Have a management committee with at least three unrelated members
Have an organisation bank account with at least two unrelated signatories
Have charitable aims evidenced by the governing document
Register with the Charity Commission if based in England or Wales with income over £5,000 per year
Ensure activities have not already started
If a national organisation, have a local presence in Cumbria

documents: Independent examination, if income is over £25,000

administered_by.quote: Cumbria Community Foundation is a charitable company limited by guarantee.

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply? • charitable, not-for-profit organisations

geography.quote: Grants to organisations for projects that benefit wildlife habitat protection and education of the natural environment in Cumbria.

access.quote: All applications are now made through our online application portal

window.quote: Most of our grants panels meet every three months. Please make sure you submit your application well in advance

amount.quote: Grants will normally be up to £2,000 over one year.

effort.quote: To apply for a grant, you will need to complete an application form through our online application portal.
Once submitted, applications are checked for eligibility and assessed against the fund's priorities.

eligibility.quote: the work you ask us to support must be legally charitable.
Have a management committee with a minimum of three unrelated members
Have a bank or building society account in the name of the organisation/group, with a minimum of two unrelated bank signatories.
Have charitable aims, evidenced by the governing document.
Register with the Charity Commission if your charitable organisation is based in England or Wales and has over £5,000 income per year.
we are unable to fund activities which have already started.
National organisations that do not have a local presence within Cumbria

after_award.quote: All grant recipients are required to submit monitoring information on their projects
We will not consider any new application unless you have submitted any outstanding end of grant monitoring reports.

documents.quote: Why do you need to have a copy of our constitution, accounts, protection policies and bank statement?
If income is over £25,000, an independent examination is required.
